summary: Richtech Robotics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its purchase of a 79,325 sq ft building in Las Vegas for $21.18M in cash via its subsidiary Richtech Rainbow Holdings. The property will serve as a US facility for warehousing, assembly, light manufacturing, and R&D. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine real estate acquisition for operational purposes, not a transformative special situation. Watch for integration updates, but there is no risk-arb angle.
